# Code of Conduct

## The short version

Be decent. Assume the other person is trying to help.

## Scope

This applies to issues, pull requests, discussions, and any other space where
someone is participating in this project.

## Expected

- Take the technical argument seriously and the person charitably.
- Say what you measured, not what you assume. Disagreements here are usually
  settled by running something.
- Mon and Burmese are welcome in issues. If you report an OCR error, the exact
  characters matter more than a translation of them.

## Not acceptable

- Personal attacks, harassment, or demeaning comments about anyone.
- Discrimination or derogatory remarks on the basis of ethnicity, nationality,
  religion, language, gender, sexuality, disability, or age. This project exists
  to serve a minority-language community, and hostility toward that community or
  any other is squarely out of place.
- Publishing anyone's private information without permission.

## Reporting

Report to **zin.min@nosbaan.com**. Reports are handled privately.

Unacceptable behaviour will be dealt with proportionately: usually a request to
stop, and if that does not work, a block. The maintainer decides, and will say
what was decided and why.

## Attribution

Adapted loosely from the Contributor Covenant. Deliberately shorter — a document
nobody finishes reading enforces nothing.
